{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Re-read the trial data with proper handling
trial_df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicate patient_id entries and determine how many samples per patient
patient_sample_counts = trial_df['patient_id'].value_counts()

# Identify patients with multiple sample_seq entries
multiple_sample_patients = patient_sample_counts[patient_sample_counts > 1]

# Print summary of patient-level data
print(f"Total number of rows: {len(trial_df)}")
print(f"Number of unique patients: {trial_df['patient_id'].nunique()}")
print(f"Patients with multiple samples (sample_seq > 1): {len(multiple_sample_patients)}")
print(f"Max sample_seq per patient: {trial_df['sample_seq'].max()}")

# Check if all patients have sample_seq = 1 or higher
assert (trial_df['sample_seq'] >= 1).all(), "sample_seq has invalid values"

# Confirm that the highest sample_seq per patient is the one to keep
# For each patient, keep only the row with the highest sample_seq
trial_df_sorted = trial_df.sort_values('sample_seq', ascending=False)
trial_df_deduped = trial_df_sorted.drop_duplicates(subset=['patient_id'], keep='first')

# Final number of enrolled patients (after deduplication)
num_enrolled_patients = len(trial_df_deduped)

# Output final count
num_enrolled_patients"}
